3. REMOVE UPPER SUSPENSION ARM
(a) Place matchmarks on both the cam plate and suspension
member.
(b) Remove the nut, cam plate and cam bolt.
Torque: 74 N,m (755 kgf-cm, 55 ft-lbf)
HINT:
At the time of installation, after stabilizing the suspension,
torque the nut.
(c) Remove the bolt, nut and upper suspension arm.
Torque: 74 N-m (755 kgf-cm, 55 tt-lbt)
NOTICE:
Do not turn the nut.
HINT:
At the time of installation, after stabilizing the suspension,
torque the bolt.
